items.headline: Copper falls after report of White House hesitancy over tariff plan
items.teaser: Copper prices saw a notable decline following reports of no movements regarding potential tariffs. The White House is currently evaluatin…
items.story: Copper prices saw a notable decline following reports of no movements regarding potential tariffs. The White House is currently evaluating worries about rising manufacturing expenses, which contributed to the drop. On the London Metal Exchange, three-month copper fell substantially from its previous record high, while COMEX copper futures also dropped, diminishing their premium over LME prices, with other LME metals experiencing similar downturns.
